senses.gloss: (b. h.) to bar, bolt; to lock up, close.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:5">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="M01848"><he>מסגר</he></cite>, <cite ref="II Kings 24:16">II Kings XXIV, 16</cite>) <he>כיון שסוֹגְרִין הלכה וכ׳</he> after they had closed the discussion about a law (declared it obscure), there was none to open again; <cite ref="Gittin 88a">Gitt. 88ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 321:16">Sifré Deut. 321</cite> <he>אהר שפותח אין סוֹגֵר</he> after he has opened (explained), none can close (raise objection). Tanḥ. Sh’mini 9 <he>עבר על כל בתי … וס׳ אותם</he> he passed over all synagogues and schools and closed them. Mekh. B’shall., s. 3 <he>הים סוגר ושונא רודף וכ׳</he> the sea forming a bar, and the enemy pursuing &c.; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21:5">Ex. R. s. 21</cite> (not <he>סגר</he>). Mekh. Yithro, Amal., s. 1 <he>מתחלה … שהיתה סוֹגֶרֶת ומְסוּגֶּרֶת וכ׳</he> formerly no slave could flee from Egypt, for it was shut up and barred (<cite ref="Joshua 6:1">Josh. VI, 1</cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10:3">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> (expl. <he>זהב סָגוּר</he>) <he>שהיה סוֹגר בעד כל וכ׳</he> it locked up the shops of all workers in gold (ruined their trade); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:4:8">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> top <he>מכסיף</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (not <he>סגור</he>); <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> <he>שהיה סגור כל וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Yoma 45a:1">Yoma 45ᵃ</cite> <he>כל החנויות נִסְגָּרוֹת</he> all (gold) shops were closed (their business ruined, v. supra); a. e.

senses.gloss: to lock up; to bind over, hand over, deliver.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 322:7">Sifré Deut. 322</cite> <he>בקשו ישראל לברוח … היו מַסְגִּירִים אותם</he> when the Israelites attempted to flee northward, they blocked their way.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 323:3">Ib. 323</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:30">Deut. XXXII, 30</cite>) <he>איני מַסְגִּיר אתכם ע״י עצמי וכ׳</he> I shall not deliver you (into the hands of the enemy) directly, but through others (who will betray you).

Ib. מוכרני מיד ומַסְגִּירַנִי מיד I sell and immediately deliver you. Tanḥ. Sh’mini l. c. (ref. to המסגר, v. supra) שכל או״ה … שהן מַסְגִּירִין לכל האומות all nations go before them into enclosures and flee, for they cause all nations to lock themselves up; a. fr.—Esp. to lock up the leper pending the priest’s observation (Lev. XIII, 4, a. e.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 5:1">Neg. V, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּסְגָּר</he> a leper under trial, opp. <he>מוחלט</he> (v. <cite ref="H01020"><he>חָלַט</he> I</cite>).

senses.gloss: to be closed, locked. Part. מְסוּגָּר, f. מְסוּגֶּרֶת, v. supra.
